name: humans-push-and-tag
body: Pushing to the remote and creating tags require explicit, per-action human consent. Absent that consent, agents must never push or tag. With explicit per-action consent for the specific action, an agent may perform any push or tag operation the human asked for — including force-push and moving, overwriting or deleting a tag; no push/tag operation remains categorically barred once that specific action is explicitly authorised. Consent is per action, never standing or blanket. One carve-out is retained: the CI release workflow may push manifest-only commits, meaning version, URL and checksum updates confined to `Formula/` and `bucket/`. Automation may only react to a consented tag (a tag created by a human, or by an agent acting under explicit per-action consent).
